topic: How does the hierarchical classification framework impact satellite link budget margins when prioritizing QoS-sensitive traffic?
consensus_response: The hierarchical classification framework impacts satellite link budget margins by prioritising QoS-sensitive traffic through tunneled vs. non-tunneled internet protocols. This approach minimizes detailed link characteristic detection, focusing on just up/down status for high latency constraints.  While DLB emphasizes bandwidth utilization and latency constraints, PNM highlights the framework's impact on resource allocation based on real-time feedback mechanisms like AMC.  This dynamic adaptation improves link budget margins by optimizing resource allocation and ensuring QoS guarantees despite fixed latencies.
